---
title: Version 1.1
---
## Released May 2005
## New Files
- Added layout.dtd file for formatting. This includes elements for page layout, system layout, staff layout, measure layout, and scaling from tenths of staff space to millimeters.
- Added to10.xsl file for transforming a MusicXML 1.1 file to a MusicXML 1.0 file. Removed the to06c.xsl file.
## New Elements
- Added `<defaults>` element, including default layout, fonts, and lyric languages.
- Added `<credit>` element for title, composer, and other credits that appear on the first page of a score.
- Added `<scaling>`, `<page-layout>`, `<system-layout>`, `<staff-layout>`, and `<measure-layout>` elements in new layout.dtd file.
- Added `<barre>` element.
- Added `<harp-pedals>` element.
- Added `<scordatura>` element.
- Added `<tremolo>` element.
- Added `<pluck>` element.
- Added `<staff-size>` element for scaling staff line spacing relative to the defaults.
## New Attributes and Entities
- Added color attribute and entity.
- Added justify entity for expanded use throughout the MusicXML DTDs.
- Added valign and halign attributes and entities for vertical and horizontal alignment.
- Added print-style entity, grouping together entities for position, font, and color.
- Added width attribute to the `<measure>` element.
- Added chord symbol formatting attributes to the `<kind>` element.
- Added height and width attributes to the `<frame>` element.
- Added a number attribute to the `<key>` and `<time>` elements so a single part such as piano can have independent key and time signatures on each staff.
- Added print-lyric attribute, used in chord sheets that include lyrics and chords but no melody.
- Added fan attribute to the `<beam>` element.
- Added line-shape entity to the `<tuplet>` element.
- Added version attribute to the top-level `<score-partwise>` and `<score-timewise>` elements for easier version detection than using the DTD's public ID.
- Added a reference attribute to the `<level>` element to indicate display-only editorial markings (such as original clefs and key signatures).
- Added enclosure attribute.
- Added level-display entity, grouping different methods of editorial markings (size, parentheses, and brackets).
## Additions to Elements
- Added `<defaults>` and `<credit>` elements to the score-header entity.
- Added more formatting attributes for positioning, font, and color to elements throughout the MusicXML DTDs. Many elements that used the position entity now use the print-style entity.
- Added optional `<page-layout>`, `<system-layout>`, `<staff-layout>`, and `<measure-layout>` elements to the `<print>` element.
- Added page-number attribute to the `<print>` element.
- Added optional `<offset>` and `<staff>` elements to the `<harmony>` element.
- Added text content to the `<glissando>` and `<slide>` elements.
- Added justify entity to the `<lyric>`, `<part-name>`, `<part-abbreviation>`, `<group-name>`, and `<group-abbreviation>` elements.
- Added the bezier attributes to the `<tied>` element.
- Added an end-length attribute to the `<ending>` element.
- Added level-display entity to the `<accidental>` element.
- Added substitution attribute to the `<heel>` and `<toe>` elements.
- Added parentheses attribute to the `<figured-bass>` element.
## New Values and Definitions
- Added inverted triangle, arrow down, arrow up, slashed, and back slashed values to the `<notehead>` element.
- Added shape-note values do, re, mi, fa, so, la, and ti to the `<notehead>` element, corresponding to Aikin's 7-shape system.
- Added the large value to the symbol-size entity.
- Added dashed value to the `<bar-style>` element.
- Added change value to the `<pedal>` element's type attribute.
- Added augmented-seventh value to the `<kind>` element.
- Defined values for the `<figured-bass>` elements.
- Elaborated and refined the definitions of the positioning attributes to make them more useful with the new 1.1 formatting features.
## Deprecated
- Deprecated the `<print>` element's staff-spacing attribute. Use the `<staff-layout>` element instead.

title: Version 2.0

## Released June 2007
## New Files
- Added container.dtd file for compressed MusicXML 2.0 files. Compressed MusicXML files are around 20 times smaller than uncompressed files, and can contain images, audio files, and other multimedia content.
- Added to11.xsl file for transforming a MusicXML 2.0 file to a MusicXML 1.1 file.
## New Elements
- Added `<image>` and `<credit-image>` elements for including graphics in scores.
- Added `<appearance>` element for general score graphical settings, including `<line-width>`, `<note-size>`, and `<other-appearance>` child elements.
- Added `<container>`, `<rootfiles>`, and `<rootfile>` elements in new container.dtd file.
- Added `<volume>`, `<pan>`, and `<elevation>` elements for better mixer support.
- Added `<solo>` and `<ensemble>` elements for better specification of playback sounds.
- Added `<metronome-note>` and `<metronome-relation>` elements for swing and other metrical markings, including `<metronome-type>`, `<metronome-dot>`, `<metronome-beam>`, and `<metronome-tuplet>` child elements.
- Added `<measure-numbering>` element for better specification of how measure numbers are displayed in each part.
- Added `<inverted-turn>` ornament element.
- Added `<stress>` and `<unstress>` articulation elements.
- Added `<part-name-display>`, `<part-abbreviation-display>`, `<group-name-display>`, `<group-abbreviation-display>`, `<display-text>`, and `<accidental-text>` elements to allow full formatting of part and group names and abbreviations.
- Added `<key-octave>` element for more accurate display of unusual key signatures.
- Added `<part-symbol>` element for formatting control of the symbol that groups multi-staff parts.
- Added `<slash-type>` and `<slash-dot>` elements for more complete specification of `<beat-repeat>` and `<slash>` notation.
- Added `<accordion-registration>` elements for accordion registration symbols, including `<accordion-high>`, `<accordion-middle>`, and `<accordion-low>` elements.
- Added `<group-time>` element for time signatures that stretch vertically across multiple staves or parts.
- Added `<relation>` element for metadata, similar to the same element in Dublin Core.
## New Attributes and Entities
- Added page attribute to the `<credit>` element.
- Added source and type attributes to the `<image>` and `<credit-image>` elements.
- Added blank-page attribute to the `<print>` element.
- Added text-x and text-y attributes to the `<ending>` element for positioning ending text.
- Added line-height and letter-spacing attributes and entities for text leading and spacing.
- Added line-through, underline, and overline attributes and text-decoration and number-of-lines entities for text decoration.
- Added rotation attribute and text-rotation entity for text rotation.
- Added dir attribute and text-direction entity for text direction.
- Added directive attribute and entity for horizontal alignment with start of time signature.
- Added plus-minus attribute to `<degree-alter>` element.
- Added attribute and value attributes to the `<supports>` element.
- Added sound attribute to `<offset>` element.
- Added new-page attribute to the `<score>` element in opus documents.
- Added element and position attributes to the `<bookmark>` and `<link>` elements for finer resolution.
- Added additional attribute to the `<clef>` element for cue and simultaneous clefs.
- Added text attribute to `<root-step>`, `<bass-step>`, `<degree-value>`, `<degree-type>`, and `<first-fret>` elements.
- Added location attribute to the `<cancel>` and `<first-fret>` elements.
- Added left-right entity for location attributes.
- Added yes-no-number, start-stop-single, and valign-image data type entities.
- Added text-formatting entity to bring various text formatting attributes and entities together.
- Added coda, divisions, and segno attributes to `<barline>` element for playback.
- Added document-attributes entity for use with top-level document elements.
## Additions to Elements
- Added formatting elements to many descendant elements of the `<harmony>` element.
- Added text content to the `<pluck>`, `<elision>`, and `<fermata>` elements.
- Added placement attribute to the `<dot>` element.
- Added type attribute to the `<tremolo>` element.
- Added print-object attribute to the `<other-notation>`, `<other-direction>`, `<harmonic>`, `<key>`, and `<clef>` elements.
- Added font and position attributes to the `<time>`, `<key>`, and `<clef>` elements.
- Allow multiple `<key>` and `<time>` elements in the `<attributes>` element.
- Added `<offset>` element to the `<sound>` element.
- Added `<part-name>` and `<part-abbreviation>` elements to the `<print>` element.
- Added enclosure and xml:lang attributes to the `<footnote>` element.
- Made `<page-height>` and `<page-width>` optional in the`<page-layout>` element.
- Added version attribute to the `<opus>` element.
- Made `<elision>` element optional in `<lyric>` elements with more than one `<text>` element to allow more formatting control.
## New Values and Definitions
- Added numeric percentage values to the `<sound>` element's damper-pedal, soft-pedal, and sostenuto-pedal attributes.
- Added single value to the type attribute of the `<other-notation>` and `<grouping>` elements.
- Added tick and short values to the `<bar-style>` element.
- Added normal, angled, and square text values to the `<fermata>` element.
- Added standard composer, lyricist, and arranger values to the type attribute for the `<creator>` element.
- Added standard music, words, and arrangement values to the type attribute for the `<rights>` element.
## Deprecated
- Deprecated the `<directive>` element. Use the `<direction>` element with the directive attribute instead.
- Deprecated the pan and elevation attributes of the `<sound>` element. Use the `<pan>` and `<elevation>` elements instead.
- Deprecated the formatting attributes for the `<part-name>`, `<part-abbreviation>`, `<group-name>`, and `<group-abbreviation>` elements. Use the `<part-name-display>`, `<part-abbreviation-display>`, `<group-name-display>`, and `<group-abbreviation-display>` elements instead.
## Updated July 2007
- Corrected the definition of the `<credit>` element in the score.mod file so it has the same meaning but is no longer non-deterministic.
## Updated September 2008
- A W3C XML Schema definition (XSD) is now available for the MusicXML 2.0 partwise, timewise, and opus documents.

title: Version 3.0

## Released August 2011
## New Files
- Added sounds.dtd file for a standard set of instrument sounds to identify musical timbre.
- Added sounds.xml file defining the initial set of 886 standard instrument sounds.
- Added to20.xsl file for transforming a MusicXML 3.0 file to a MusicXML 2.0 file.
## New Elements
- Added `<instrument-sound>` element for describing timbre for playback. The standard sounds listed in the sounds.xml file may be used.
- Added `<virtual-instrument>`, `<virtual-library>`, and `<virtual-name>` elements for specifying a specific virtual instrument sound.
- Added `<sounds>`, `<sound>`, `<any>`, `<solo>`, and `<ensemble>` elements in new sounds.dtd file.
- Added `<play>` and `<other-play>` elements for playback techniques.
- Added `<ipa>` element for International Phonetic Alphabet sounds in vocal music.
- Added `<mute>` element for mute playback techniques with different instruments.
- Added `<semi-pitched>` element for playback categories of indefinite pitch.
- Added `<system-dividers>`, `<left-divider>`, and `<right-divider>` elements for system separation marks.
- Added `<string-mute>` element for string mute on/off symbols.
- Added `<principal-voice>` element for principal and secondary voices, including Hauptstimme and Nebenstimme.
- Added `<percussion>`, `<glass>`, `<metal>`, `<wood>`, `<pitched>`, `<membrane>`, `<effect>`, `<timpani>`, `<beater>`, `<stick>`, `<stick-material>`, `<stick-type>`, `<stick-location>`, and `<other-percussion>` elements for percussion pictogram symbols.
- Added `<distance>` element for standard distance between notation elements.
- Added `<credit-type>` element for purpose behind a `<credit>`.
- Added `<hole>`, `<hole-closed>`, `<hole-shape>`, and `<hole-type>` elements for woodwind/brass fingerings and other notations.
- Added `<handbell>` element for techniques used in handbell and handchime music.
- Added `<notehead-text>` element for text inside a notehead.
- Added `<arrow>`, `<arrow-direction>`, `<arrow-style>`, and `<circular-arrow>` elements for arrows used as musical technical indications.
- Added `<delayed-inverted-turn>` element for inverted turns delayed until the end of the current note.
- Added `<vertical-turn>` element for turn shape arranged vertically going from upper left to lower right.
- Added `<interchangeable>` and `<time-relation>` elements for specifying interchangeable or dual time signatures, such as 3/4 (6/8).
- Added `<key-accidental>` element for specifying accidentals in non-traditional key signatures.
## New Attributes and Entities
- Added measure attribute to the `<rest>` element.
- Added winged attribute to the `<repeat>` element.
- Added niente attribute to the `<wedge>` element.
- Added unplayed attribute to the `<frame>` element.
- Added symbol attribute to the `<degree-value>` element.
- Added dash-length and space-length attributes to the `<tied>`, `<slur>`, `<glissando>`, `<slide>`, `<scoop>`, `<plop>`, `<doit>`, `<falloff>`, `<wedge>`, `<bracket>`, `<dashes>`, and `<octave-shift>` elements.
- Added slash attribute to the `<turn>`, `<delayed-turn>`, and `<inverted-turn>` elements.
- Added approach and departure attributes to the `<mordent>` and `<inverted-mordent>` elements.
- Added time-separator and time-symbol entities for displaying time signatures.
- Added separator attribute to the `<time>` element for displaying the arrangement of beat and beat-type values.
- Added after-barline attribute to the `<clef>` element.
- Added xml:space attribute to the text-formatting entity.
## Additions to Elements
- Added comma and tick values to the `<breath-mark>` element.
- Added `<midi-device>` element to the `<sound>` element.
- Added multiple `<midi-device>` elements to the `<score-part>` element.
- Added default-x, default-y, relative-x, relative-y, and type attributes to the `<extend>` element.
- Added underline, overline, line-through, and enclosure attributes to the `<dynamics>` element.
- Added time-only attribute to the `<tie>` element.
- Added number attribute to the `<transpose>` element.
- Added optional content to the `<senza-misura>` element for specifying a symbol.
- Added print-object attributes to the `<notations>` and `<lyric>` elements.
- Added halign and valign attributes to the `<dynamics>`, `<coda>`, `<segno>`, `<rehearsal>`, `<metronome>`, `<accordion-registration>`, `<damp>`, `<damp-all>` `<eyeglasses>`, `<harp-pedals>`, `<pedal>`, `<other-direction>`, `<measure-numbering>`, and `<time>` elements.
- Added letter-spacing and line-height attributes to the `<rehearsal>` element.
- Added id attribute to the `<midi-device>` element.
## New Values and Definitions
- Added jianpu value to the `<sign>` element for clefs.
- Added square value to the `<group-symbol>` and `<part-symbol>` elements.
- Added square, circle, bracket, triangle, and diamond values to the enclosure attribute for the `<words>`, `<credit-words>`, `<display-text>`, and `<accidental-text>` elements.
- Added rectangle, oval, bracket, triangle, and diamond values to the enclosure attribute for the `<rehearsal>` element.
- Added 1024th, 512th, and maxima values to the `<type>` element.
- Added 7 and 8 to number attribute values for the `<beam>` and `<metronome-beam>` elements via the beam-level entity.
- Added 7 and 8 to the values for the `<tremolo>` element.
- Added fa up, circle dot, left triangle, and rectangle values to the `<notehead>` element.
- Added sharp-down, sharp-up, natural-down, natural-up, flat-down, flat-up, triple-sharp, triple-flat, slash-quarter-sharp, slash-sharp, slash-flat, double-slash-flat, sharp-1, sharp-2, sharp-3, sharp-5, flat-1, flat-2, flat-3, flat-4, sori, and koron values to the `<accidental>`, `<accidental-mark>`, and `<accidental-text>` elements.
- Added continue value to the type attribute for the `<tied>`, `<wedge>`, `<dashes>`, `<bracket>`, `<octave-shift>`, and `<pedal>` elements.
- Added before-barline value to the location attribute for the `<cancel>` element.
- Added note and dotted-note values to the symbol attribute for the `<time>` element.
## Deprecated
- Deprecated the repeater attribute of the `<beam>` element. Use the `<tremolo>` element instead.
## Updated September 2011
- Corrected the definition of the `<frame>` element’s unplayed attribute in the direction.mod and musicxml.xsd files to match the documentation.
## Updated June 2015
- Corrected the parttime.xsl and timepart.xsl stylesheets to output the MusicXML 3.0 public ID rather than the MusicXML 2.0 public ID.

---
title: Version 3.1
---
## Released December 2017

## Licensing Changes

*   MusicXML 3.1 is now licensed under the W3C Community Final Specification Agreement rather than the MusicXML Public License 3.0. ([Issue 114](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/114))

## Packaging Changes

*   MusicXML 3.1 now recommends .musicxml rather than .xml as the file extension for uncompressed MusicXML files. ([Issue 191](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/191))
*   MusicXML 3.1 adds a new file called mimetype as the first file in the zip container of a compressed MusicXML file. The file is uncompressed and has the string application/vnd.recordare.musicxml as its content. ([Issue 185](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/185))
*   MusicXML 3.1 files now have recommended Uniform Type Identifiers. ([Issue 50](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/50))

## Schema Additions

### New Elements

*   The [`<arrowhead>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/arrowhead/) element represents arrowheads without an arrow stem. ([Issue 183](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/183))
*   The [`<beat-unit-tied>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/beat-unit-tied/) element represents tied notes in regular metronome marks. ([Issue 92](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/92))
*   The [`<brass-bend>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/brass-bend/) element represents the u-shaped bend symbol used in brass notation. ([Issue 44](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/44))
*   The [`<credit-symbol>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/credit-symbol/) element specifies a musical symbol using a canonical SMuFL glyph name. It is used when an occasional musical symbol is interspersed into text. ([Issue 163](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/163))
*   The [`<except-voice>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/except-voice/) element is used to specify a combination of slash notation and regular notation. ([Issue 231](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/231))
*   The [`<figure>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/figure/) element may now have the [`<footnote>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/footnote/) and [`<level>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/level/) elements as optional child elements. ([Issue 94](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/94))
*   The [`<flip>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/flip/) element represents the flip symbol used in brass notation. ([Issue 44](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/44))
*   The [`<glyph>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/glyph/) element represents what SMuFL glyph should be used for different variations of symbols that are semantically identical. ([Issue 64](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/64), [Issue 71](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/71), [Issue 72](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/72))
*   The [`<golpe>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/golpe/) element represents the golpe symbol that is used for tapping the pick guard in guitar music. ([Issue 100](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/100))
*   The [`<half-muted>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/half-muted/) element represents the half-muted symbol which looks like a circle with a plus sign inside. ([Issue 44](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/44))
*   The [`<harmon-mute>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/harmon-mute/) element represents the symbols used for harmon mutes in brass notation. ([Issue 44](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/44))
*   The [`<haydn>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/haydn/) element represents the Haydn ornament, defined in SMuFL as ornamentHaydn. ([Issue 95](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/95))
*   The [`<inverted-vertical-turn>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/inverted-vertical-turn/) element represents the turn symbol shape arranged vertically going from upper left to lower right. ([Issue 95](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/95))
*   The [`<metronome-arrows>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/metronome-arrows/) element indicates the presence of metric modulation arrows on both sides of the metronome mark. ([Issue 93](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/93))
*   The [`<metronome-tied>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/metronome-tied/) element represents tied notes in metric modulations and other metric relationships. ([Issue 92](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/92))
*   The [`<n>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/n/) element represents an n dynamic. ([Issue 52](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/52))
*   A single [`<note>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/note/) element may now have both [`<cue>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/cue/) and [`<grace>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/grace/) child elements. ([Issue 68](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/68))
*   The [`<open>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/open/) element represents the open symbol, which looks like a circle. ([Issue 44](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/44))
*   The [`<pf>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/pf/) element represents a pf dynamic. ([Issue 52](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/52))
*   The [`<sfzp>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/sfzp/) element represents an sfzp dynamic. ([Issue 52](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/52))
*   The [`<smear>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/smear/) element represents the tilde-shaped smear symbol used in brass notation. ([Issue 44](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/44))
*   The [`<soft-accent>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/soft-accent/) element indicates a soft accent that is not as heavy as a normal accent. It is often notated as <>. ([Issue 131](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/131))
*   The [`<staff-divide>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/staff-divide/) element represents staff division arrow symbols. ([Issue 11](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/11))
*   The [`<symbol>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/symbol/) element specifies a musical symbol using a canonical SMuFL glyph name. It is used when an occasional musical symbol is interspersed into text. ([Issue 163](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/163))

*   The time-only attribute has been added to the [`<lyric>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/lyric/) element. ([Issue 151](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/151))

### New Values

*   New values double-sharp-down, double-sharp-up, flat-flat-down, flat-flat-up, arrow-down, arrow-up, and other have been added to the [accidental-value](../../musicxml-reference/data-types/accidental-value/) type, used by the [`<accidental>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/accidental/), [`<accidental-mark>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/accidental-mark/), [`<accidental-text>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/accidental-text/), and [`<key-accidental>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/key-accidental/) elements. ([Issue 83](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/83))
*   New values drum stick and superball have been added to the [beater-value](../../musicxml-reference/data-types/beater-value/) type, used by the [`<beater>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/beater/) element. ([Issue 85](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/85))
*   The slide brush on gong value has been added to the [beater-value](../../musicxml-reference/data-types/beater-value/) type, used by the [`<beater>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/beater/) element. ([Issue 76](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/76))
*   The salzedo and upbow values have been added to the [breath-mark-value](../../musicxml-reference/data-types/breath-mark-value/) type, used by the [`<breath-mark>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/breath-mark/) element. ([Issue 9](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/9))
*   The [`<caesura>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/caesura/) element uses the new [caesura-value](../../musicxml-reference/data-types/caesura-value/) type with values of normal, thick, short, curved, and single. An empty string value is included for compatibility with MusicXML 3.0. ([Issue 9](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/9))
*   New values lotus flute and megaphone have been added to the [effect](../../musicxml-reference/data-types/effect-value/) type, used by the [`<effect>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/effect/) element. ([Issue 73](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/73))
*   New values pentagon, hexagon, heptagon, octagon, nonagon, and decagon have been added to the [enclosure-shape](../../musicxml-reference/data-types/enclosure-shape/) type, used by the enclosure attribute. ([Issue 86](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/86))
*   New values double-angled, double-square, double-dot, half-curve, and curlew have been added to the [fermata-shape](../../musicxml-reference/data-types/fermata-shape/) type, used by the [`<fermata>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/fermata/) element. ([Issue 9](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/9))
*   New values glass harmonica and glass harp have been added to the [glass-value](../../musicxml-reference/data-types/glass-value/) type, used by the [`<glass>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/glass/) element. ([Issue 81](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/81))
*   The belltree value has been added to the [handbell-value](../../musicxml-reference/data-types/handbell-value/) type, used by the [`<handbell>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/handbell/) element. ([Issue 79](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/79))
*   New values Chinese tomtom, cuica, Indo-American tomtom, Japanese tomtom, and tabla have been added to the [membrane](../../musicxml-reference/data-types/membrane-value/) type, used by the [`<membrane>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/membrane/) element. ([Issue 75](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/75))
*   New values agogo, bell tree, cencerro, jingle bells, and shell bells have been added to the [metal](../../musicxml-reference/data-types/metal-value/) type, used by the [`<metal>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/metal/) element. ([Issue 78](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/78))
*   The chain rattle value has been added to the [metal](../../musicxml-reference/data-types/metal-value/) type, used by the [`<metal>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/metal/) element. ([Issue 74](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/74))
*   New values jaw harp and musical saw have been added to the [metal](../../musicxml-reference/data-types/metal-value/) type, used by the [`<metal>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/metal/) element. ([Issue 81](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/81))
*   The tam tam with beater value has been added to the [metal](../../musicxml-reference/data-types/metal-value/) type, used by the [`<metal>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/metal/) element. ([Issue 76](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/76))
*   The circled value has been added to [notehead-value](../../musicxml-reference/data-types/notehead-value/) type, used by the [`<notehead>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/notehead/) element. ([Issue 91](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/91))
*   The other value has been added to [notehead-value](../../musicxml-reference/data-types/notehead-value/) type, used by the [`<notehead>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/notehead/) element. ([Issue 110](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/110))
*   The sostenuto value has been added to the [pedal-type](../../musicxml-reference/data-types/pedal-type/) type, used by the type attribute of the [`<pedal>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/pedal/) element. ([Issue 102](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/102))
*   New values celesta, lithophone, steel drums, and tubaphone have been added to the [pitched-value](../../musicxml-reference/data-types/pitched-value/) type, used by the [`<pitched>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/pitched/) element. ([Issue 82](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/82))
*   The plus value has been added to the [`<prefix>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/prefix/) element. ([Issue 94](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/94))
*   New values glockenspiel, gum, hammer, superball, and wound have been added to the [stick-type](../../musicxml-reference/data-types/stick-type/) type, used by the [`<stick-type>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/stick-type/) element. ([Issue 85](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/85))
*   The grace-cue value has been added to the [symbol-size](../../musicxml-reference/data-types/symbol-size/) type, used by the size attribute. ([Issue 68](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/68))
*   New values back-slash, plus, and vertical have been added to the [`<suffix>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/suffix/) element. ([Issue 94](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/94))
*   The let-ring value has been added to the type attribute of the [`<tied>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/tied/) element. ([Issue 142](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/142))
*   The grace-cue value has been added to the n[ote-size-type](../../musicxml-reference/data-types/note-size-type/) type, used by the type attribute. ([Issue 68](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/68))
*   The unmeasured value has been added to the [tremolo-type](../../musicxml-reference/data-types/tremolo-type/) type, used by the type attribute of the [`<tremolo>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/tremolo/) element. ([Issue 99](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/99))
*   New values bamboo scraper, castanets with handle, football rattle, quijada, reco-reco, and whip have been added to the [wood](../../musicxml-reference/data-types/wood-value/) type, used by the [`<wood>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/wood/) element. ([Issue 77](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/77))
*   The rainstick value has been added to the [wood](../../musicxml-reference/data-types/wood-value/) type, used by the [`<wood>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/wood/) element. ([Issue 74](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/74))

## Removed and Deprecated Features

*   The font-family, font-size, font-style, and font-weight attributes have been removed from the [`<extend>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/extend/) element. The <extend> element contains no text, and these attributes were added by mistake in MusicXML 1.1. ([Issue 140](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/140))
*   The bezier-offset and bezier-offset2 attributes are deprecated as of MusicXML 3.1. ([Issue 26](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/26))

## Documentation Changes

MusicXML 3.1 made the following changes to the XSD and DTD schema documentation.

*   The DTD documentation for the [`<actual-notes>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/actual-notes/) and [`<normal-notes>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/normal-notes/) elements has been corrected to fix a typo. ([Issue 138](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/138))
*   The XSD and DTD documentation for the [`<accordion-high>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/accordion-high/), [`<accordion-low>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/accordion-low/), and [`<accordion-middle>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/accordion-middle/) elements clarifies that the elements are omitted if no dots are present. ([Issue 134](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/134))
*   The XSD and DTD documentation for the attack and release attributes and their interrelationship has been clarified. ([Issue 58](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/58))
*   The XSD and DTD documentation for the bezier-x, bezier-y, bezier-x2, bezier-y2, bezier-offset, and bezier-offset2 attributes and their interrelationships has been clarified. ([Issue 25](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/25), [Issue 26](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/26))
*   The cancel complex type XSD documentation now describes the location attribute correctly. ([Issue 18](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/18))
*   The [`<cue>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/cue/) element XSD and DTD documentation clarifies that the <cue> element indicates silent notes. ([Issue 67](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/67))
*   The [`<direction>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/direction/) element XSD and DTD documentation clarifies the relationship between <direction> and [`<note>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/note/) elements. ([Issue 170](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/170))
*   The [`<falloff>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/falloff/) element XSD documentation has been corrected to indicate the falloff comes after the note. ([Issue 17](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/17))
*   The interchangeable complex type XSD documentation no longer refers to a non-existent parentheses attribute. ([Issue 12](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/12))
*   The [`<key-octave>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/key-octave/) element XSD and DTD documentation clarifies the behavior of the cancel attribute. ([Issue 126](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/126))
*   The multiple-rest complex type XSD documentation no longer refers to a non-existent type attribute. ([Issue 15](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/15))
*   The note-type complex type XSD documentation now refers to 1024th to maxima instead of 256th to long. ([Issue 16](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/16))
*   The [number-level](../../musicxml-reference/data-types/number-level/) simple type XSD documentation now refers to an optional rather than implied value. ([Issue 19](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/19))
*   The [string-number](../../musicxml-reference/data-types/string-number/) simple type and [`<string>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/string/) element XSD and DTD documentation clarifies how string numbers are ordered. ([Issue 127](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/127))
*   The [`<tied>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/tied/) element XSD and DTD documentation clarifies how to represent different types of single-ended tie symbols. ([Issue 142](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/142))
*   The [`<wavy-line>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/wavy-line/) element XSD and DTD documentation now refers to [`<barline>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/barline/) rather than [`<measure>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/measure-partwise/) elements. ([Issue 13](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/13))

---
title: Version 4.0
---
## Released June 2021

## Packaging Changes

*   MusicXML 4.0 specifies a standard way to represent both score and parts in a single compressed .mxl file. ([Issue 278](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/278))
*   MusicXML 4.0 now contains a standard [XML catalog](../../listings/catalog.xml/) to make local validation easier. ([Issue 259](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/259))
*   MusicXML 4.0 now contains W3C XML Schema versions of the [container](../../listings/container.xsd/) and [sounds](../../listings/sounds.xsd/) document definitions, replacing the deprecated DTD versions. ([Issue 401](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/401))

## Schema Additions

### New Elements

*   The [`<assess>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/assess/) element specifies how default assessment should be overridden for individual notes. ([Issue 294](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/294))
*   The [`<bass-separator>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/bass-separator/) element indicates that text, rather than a line or slash, separates the bass from what precedes it. ([Issue 307](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/307))
*   The [`<concert-score>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/concert-score/) element indicates that a score is displayed in concert pitch. ([Issue 39](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/39), [Issue 279](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/279))
*   The [`<first>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/first/) element represents the first of two consecutive notes in a swing ratio. ([Issue 283](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/283))
*   The [`<for-part>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/for-part/) element is used in a concert score to indicate the transposition for a transposed part created from that score. ([Issue 279](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/279))
*   The [`<instrument-change>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/instrument-change/) element represents a change to the virtual instrument sound for a given [`<score-instrument>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/score-instrument/). ([Issue 293](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/293))
*   The [`<line-detail>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/line-detail/) element specifies the appearance of a line in the staff. ([Issue 305](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/305))
*   The [`<listen>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/listen/) element specifies different ways that a score following or machine listening application can interact with a performer. It represents interactions that are specific to a note. ([Issue 294](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/294))
*   The [`<listening>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/listening/) element specifies different ways that a score following or machine listening application can interact with a performer. It represents interactions that change the state of the listening application from the specified point in the performance onward. ([Issue 294](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/294))
*   The [`<note>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/note/) element may now contain multiple [`<instrument>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/instrument/) elements. ([Issue 277](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/277))
*   The [`<numeral>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/numeral/) element represents the Roman numeral or Nashville number part of a harmony. It requires that the key be specified in the encoding. ([Issue 295](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/295))
*   The [`<numeral-alter>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/numeral-alter/) element represents an alteration to the [`<numeral-root>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/numeral-root/). ([Issue 295](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/295))
*   The [`<numeral-fifths>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/numeral-fifths/) element specifies the reference key for the [`<numeral>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/numeral/) in the same way as the [`<fifths>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/fifths/) element. ([Issue 295](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/295))
*   The [`<numeral-key>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/numeral-key/) element is used when the key for the [`<numeral>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/numeral/) is different than the key specified by the key signature. ([Issue 295](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/295))
*   The [`<numeral-mode>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/numeral-mode/) element specifies the scale that is used to interpret the [`<numeral-root>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/numeral-root/) element values. ([Issue 295](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/295))
*   The [`<numeral-root>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/numeral-root/) element represents the Roman numeral or Nashville number as a positive integer from 1 to 7. ([Issue 295](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/295))
*   The [`<other-listen>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/other-listen/) element represents other types of listening control and interaction that are specific to a note. ([Issue 294](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/294))
*   The [`<other-listening>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/other-listening/) element represents other types of listening control and interaction that change the state of the listening application from the specified point in the performance onward. ([Issue 294](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/294))
*   The [`<part-clef>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/part-clef/) element is used for transpositions from concert scores that also include a change of clef, as for instruments such as bass clarinet. ([Issue 55](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/55))
*   The [`<part-link>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/part-link/) element allows MusicXML data for both score and parts to be contained within a single compressed MusicXML file. It links a [`<score-part>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/score-part/) from a score document to MusicXML documents that contain parts data. ([Issue 278](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/278))
*   The [`<part-transpose>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/part-transpose/) element specifies the transposition for a transposed part created from the existing score file. ([Issue 279](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/279))
*   The [`<player>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/player/) element allows for multiple players per [`<score-part>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/score-part/) for use in listening applications. ([Issue 294](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/294))
*   The [`<second>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/second/) element represents the second of two consecutive notes in a swing ratio. ([Issue 283](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/283))
*   The [`<straight>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/straight/) element specifies that no swing is present, so consecutive notes have equal durations. ([Issue 283](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/283))
*   The [`<swing>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/swing/) element specifies whether or not to use swing playback, where consecutive on-beat / off-beat eighth or 16th notes are played with unequal nominal durations. ([Issue 283](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/283))
*   The [`<swing-style>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/swing-style/) element describes the style of swing used. ([Issue 283](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/283))
*   The [`<swing-type>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/swing-type/) element specifies the note type, either eighth or 16th, to which the [`<first>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/first/) to [`<second>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/second/) ratio is applied. ([Issue 283](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/283))
*   The [`<sync>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/sync/) element specifies the style that a score following application should use the synchronize an accompaniment with a performer. ([Issue 294](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/294))
*   The [`<wait>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/wait/) element specifies a point where the accompaniment should wait for a performer event before continuing. ([Issue 294](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/294))

### New Attributes

*   The above attribute has been added to the [`<double>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/double/) element. ([Issue 368](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/368))
*   The arrangement attribute has been added to the [`<bass>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/bass/) and [`<harmony>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/harmony/) elements. ([Issue 307](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/307))
*   The after-jump attribute has been added to the [`<repeat>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/repeat/) element. ([Issue 322](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/322))
*   The halign and valign attributes have been added to the [`<figured-bass>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/figured-bass/) element. ([Issue 362](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/362))
*   The multiple-rest-always and multiple-rest-range attributes have been added to the [`<measure-numbering>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/measure-numbering/) element. ([Issue 310](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/310))
*   The offset attribute has been added to the [`<release>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/release/) element. ([Issue 203](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/203))
*   The placement attribute have been added to the [`<figured-bass>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/figured-bass/) element. ([Issue 336](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/336))
*   The print-object attribute has been added to the [`<metronome>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/metronome/) element. ([Issue 355](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/355))
*   The scaling attribute has been added to the [`<staff-size>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/staff-size/) element. ([Issue 305](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/305))
*   The shape attribute has been added to the [`<bend>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/bend/) element. ([Issue 306](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/306))
*   The smufl attribute has been added to the [`<effect>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/effect/), [`<membrane>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/membrane/), [`<metal>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/metal/), [`<timpani>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/timpani/), and [`<wood>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/wood/) elements. ([Issue 403](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/403))
*   The smufl attribute has been added to the [`<wavy-line>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/wavy-line/) element. ([Issue 397](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/397))
*   The staff attribute has been added to the [`<measure-numbering>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/measure-numbering/) element. ([Issue 23](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/23))
*   The system attribute has been added to the [`<direction>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/direction/), [`<ending>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/ending/), [`<harmony>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/harmony/), and [`<measure-numbering>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/measure-numbering/) elements. ([Issue 37](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/37))
*   The text attribute has been added to the [`<inversion>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/inversion/) element. ([Issue 295](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/295))
*   The type attribute has been added to the [`<level>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/level/) element. ([Issue 288](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/288))
*   The unbroken attribute has been added to the [`<arpeggiate>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/arpeggiate/) element. ([Issue 281](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/281))

### New Values

*   The [smufl-accidental-glyph-name](../../musicxml-reference/data-types/smufl-accidental-glyph-name/) type used by the smufl attribute of the [`<accidental>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/accidental/), [`<accidental-mark>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/accidental-mark/), [`<accidental-text>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/accidental-text/), and [`<key-accidental>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/key-accidental/) elements now allows SMuFL accidental glyphs from the [Medieval and Renaissance accidentals](https://www.w3.org/2021/03/smufl14/tables/medieval-and-renaissance-accidentals.html) and [Kievan square notation](https://www.w3.org/2021/03/smufl14/tables/kievan-square-notation.html) ranges. ([Issue 330](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/330))
*   The part name value has been added to the list of standard [`<credit-type>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/credit-type/) element values. ([Issue 282](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/282))
*   The inverted-bracket value has been added to the [enclosure-shape](../../musicxml-reference/data-types/enclosure-shape/) type, used by the enclosure attribute. ([Issue 308](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/308))
*   Eight new sound IDs have been added to the sounds.xml file for use by the [`<instrument-sound>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/instrument-sound/) element. They are wind.flutes.whistle.tin.c ([Issue 289](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/289)) and drum.tabor, drum.tamborim, pitched-percussion.handchimes, pluck.cavaquinho, wind.reed.clarinet.d, wind.reed.clarinet.g, and wind.reed.clarinet.piccolo. ([Issue 363](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/363))
*   Element content for the [`<ipa>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/ipa/) element has been updated to IPA 2015 symbols represented in Unicode 13.0. ([Issue 345](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/345))
*   The highest value for the [number-level](../../musicxml-reference/data-types/number-level/) type, used by the number attribute, has been raised from 6 to 16. ([Issue 297](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/297))
*   The discontinue value has been added to the [pedal-type](../../musicxml-reference/data-types/pedal-type/) type, used by the type attribute of the [`<pedal>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/pedal/) element. ([Issue 302](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/302))
*   The resume value has been added to the [pedal-type](../../musicxml-reference/data-types/pedal-type/) type, used by the type attribute of the [`<pedal>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/pedal/) element. ([Issue 335](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/335))

## Removed and Deprecated Features

*   The DTD versions of the MusicXML definitions have been deprecated in favor of the XSD versions. This includes the midixml DTD and XSL files, which will not be replaced with XSD versions. ([Issue 401](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/401))
*   Empty [`<multiple-rest>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/multiple-rest/) elements are no longer allowed. This was a mistake in the original definition of the element. ([Issue 249](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/249))
*   The [`<function>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/function/) element is deprecated as of MusicXML 4.0. Use the [`<numeral>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/numeral/) element instead. ([Issue 295](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/295))
*   The none value in the [clef-sign](../../musicxml-reference/data-types/clef-sign/) type used by the [`<sign>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/sign/) element is deprecated as of MusicXML 4.0. ([Issue 304](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/304))

## Documentation Changes

*   The W3C Music Notation Community Group Report for MusicXML 4.0 now includes complete documentation. Previously this was only available for MusicXML 3.0 on MakeMusic's musicxml.com site and had not been updated for Version 3.1. ([Issue 353](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/353))
*   Help has been added for working around common [code generation issues](../../tutorial/code-generation/). ([Issue 280](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/280))
*   The [`<arpeggiate>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/arpeggiate/) element documentation clarifies how to export the length of an arpeggio line. ([Issue 62](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/62))
*   The [`<beat-repeat>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/beat-repeat/) and [`<measure-repeat>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/measure-repeat/) element documentation clarifies the behavior of the type attribute. ([Issue 287](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/287))
*   The [`<bend-alter>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/bend-alter/) element documentation clarifies the meaning of the element content when there are multiple bends on a single note. ([Issue 204](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/204))
*   The [`<chord>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/chord/) and [`<duration>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/duration/) element documentation clarifies the behavior of chords with notes of different durations. ([Issue 106](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/106))
*   The [`<defaults>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/defaults/), [`<measure-layout>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/measure-layout/), [`<page-layout>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/page-layout/), [`<staff-layout>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/staff-layout/), and [`<system-layout>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/system-layout/) element documentation clarifies the behavior when layout elements are missing from the [`<print>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/print/) element. ([Issue 53](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/53))
*   The [`<diatonic>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/diatonic/) and [`<octave-change>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/octave-change/) element documentation clarifies the representation of transpositions of an octave or more. ([Issue 333](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/333))
*   The [`<dynamics>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/dynamics/) element documentation clarifies how the relationship of the placement attributes in the <dynamics> and [`<direction>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/direction/) elements. ([Issue 43](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/43))
*   The [`<ending>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/ending/) element documentation now describes the number attribute correctly. ([Issue 291](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/291))
*   The [`<kind>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/kind/) element documentation clarifies how to represent suspended chord symbols. ([Issue 352](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/352))
*   The [`<kind>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/kind/) element documentation clarifies how to represent N.C. chord symbols. ([Issue 349](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/349))
*   The [`<level>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/level/) element documentation clarifies the purpose of the element content. ([Issue 146](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/146))
*   The [`<line>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/line/) element documentation clarifies that the element is only needed with G, F, and C signs. ([Issue 351](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/351))
*   The [`<lyric>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/lyric/) element documentation clarifies how lyrics are aligned. ([Issue 261](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/261))
*   The [`<measure-repeat>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/measure-repeat/) element documentation clarifies that the actual music should be repeated in each measure. ([Issue 254](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/254))
*   The [`<notehead>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/notehead/) element documentation now specifies the treatment of the [Note name noteheads supplement range](https://www.w3.org/2021/03/smufl14/tables/note-name-noteheads-supplement.html) added in SMuFL 1.4. ([Issue 382](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/382))
*   The [number-level](../../musicxml-reference/data-types/number-level/) data type documentation clarifies that different values are used to distinguish elements that overlap in MusicXML document order rather than musical score order. ([Issue 8](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/8))
*   The [`<offset>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/offset/) element documentation clarifies the current musical location at the end of a measure. ([Issue 28](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/28))
*   The [`<rehearsal>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/rehearsal/) element documentation clarifies that it can be used to represent section names. ([Issue 311](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/311))
*   The [staff-type](../../musicxml-reference/data-types/staff-type/) data type documentation now describes the different options more completely. ([Issue 292](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/292))
*   The [staff-type](../../musicxml-reference/data-types/staff-type/) data type documentation now encourages the use of an alternate [`<staff-type>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/staff-type/) element where appropriate ([Issue 205](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/205))
*   The documentation for the [start-stop](../../musicxml-reference/data-types/start-stop/), [start-stop-continue](../../musicxml-reference/data-types/start-stop-continue/), [start-stop-single](../../musicxml-reference/data-types/start-stop-single/), and [tied-type](../../musicxml-reference/data-types/tied-type/) data types clarifies that multiple elements with the same tag on the same note should appear in musical score order. ([Issue 8](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/8))
*   The [`<system-layout>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/system-layout/) element documentation clarifies usage within a [`<print>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/print/) element. ([Issue 339](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/339))

title: Version 4.1 Draft
---
## Draft

## Schema Additions

### New Elements

*   The [`<part-symbol>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/part-symbol/) element now has cardinality 0..N instead of 0..1, to allow grouping staves in multiple groups within a part. ([Issue 572](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/572))

*   The [`<coda>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/coda/) and [`<segno>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/segno/) elements in [`<barline>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/barline/) now have cardinality 0..N instead of 0..1, same as their cardinality within [`<direction-type>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/direction-type/). ([Issue 653](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/653))

*   The [`<accidental>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/accidental/) and [`<key-accidental>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/key-accidental/) elements now have cardinality 0..N instead of 0..1, to support microtonal music. ([Issue 605](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/605))

*   The [`<voice-direction>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/voice-direction/) element distinguishes between upper and lower voices on a staff. The [`<voice-directions>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/voice-directions/) element contains multiple `<voice-direction>` entries. ([Issue 662](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/662))

### New Attributes

*   The `@number` attribute has been added to the [`<harmonic>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/harmonic/) element to accommodate multiple harmonics per chord. ([Issue 529](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/529))

### New Values

*   The following values have been added to the [`beater-value`](../../musicxml-reference/data-types/beater-value/) data type: `soft xylophone beaters`, `brass mallets`. ([Issue 716](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/716))

## Removed and Deprecated Features

*   The timewise format and [`<score-timewise>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/score-timewise/) element are now deprecated. ([Issue 483](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/483))

## Documentation Changes

*   The ["Hello World" in MusicXML tutorial](../../tutorial/hello-world/) reflects the deprecation of XML Document Type Definition (DTD) files in favor of XML Schema Definition (XSD) files.
*   The [`<beam>/@fan`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/beam/) attribute documentation clarifies multi-level beam usage. ([Issue 663](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/663))
*   The [`<senza-misura>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/senza-misura/) element documentation clarifies the expected symbol values. ([Issue 643](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/643))
*   The [`<rest>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/rest/) and [`<display-step>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/display-step/) elements documentation clarify the vertical alignment for rest symbols in relation to their SMuFL glyphs. ([Issue 681](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/681))
*   The [`<time>/@symbol`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/time/) attribute and associated [`time-symbol`](../../musicxml-reference/data-types/time-symbol/) data type documentation clarifies the meaning of the "single-number" value. ([Issue 641](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/641))
*   The usage of [`<supports type="no">`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/supports/) is clarified, especially in the context of absence of [`<accidental>`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/accidentals/). ([Issue 664](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/664))
*   Removed mention of ISO 639 for languages codes, and updated **xml.xsd** to the latest version [http://www.w3.org/2009/01/xml.xsd](http://www.w3.org/2009/01/xml.xsd). ([Issue 573](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/573))
*   The [`<beater>/@tip`](../../musicxml-reference/elements/beater/) attribute documentation clarifies the possibility of specifying invalid SMuFL combinations of beater directions. ([Issue 716](https://github.com/w3c-cg/musicxml/issues/716))

FILE: docs/src/xsl/datatypes.xsl
================================================
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>

<!--
  Generate a JSON listing of all data types in an XSD schema.
-->

<xsl:stylesheet
  version="3.0"
  xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform"
  xmlns:xs="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"
  xmlns:map="http://www.w3.org/2005/xpath-functions/map"
  xmlns:array="http://www.w3.org/2005/xpath-functions/array"
  xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"
  xmlns:fn="http://www.w3.org/2005/xpath-functions"
  exclude-result-prefixes="#all"
>
  <xsl:output method="json" indent="yes" encoding="UTF-8"/>

  <!-- Build an XML listing of data types based on the XSD schema. -->
  <xsl:mode on-no-match="deep-skip"/>
  <xsl:variable name="xlink" select="fn:doc(fn:replace(fn:document-uri(), fn:tokenize(fn:document-uri(), '/')[last()], 'xlink.xsd'))"/>
  <xsl:variable name="xml" select="fn:doc(fn:replace(fn:document-uri(), fn:tokenize(fn:document-uri(), '/')[last()], 'xml.xsd'))"/>

  <xsl:template match="/">
    <xsl:variable name="datatypes" as="map(*)*">
      <xsl:apply-templates select="xs:schema/xs:simpleType">
        <xsl:with-param name="name" select="()"/>
      </xsl:apply-templates>
      <xsl:apply-templates mode="xs-ref" select="xs:schema//xs:attribute[@ref]"/>
      <xsl:apply-templates mode="xs-type" select="xs:schema//xs:attribute[starts-with(@type, 'xs:')]"/>
      <xsl:apply-templates select="xs:schema//xs:extension[starts-with(@base, 'xs:')]"/>
    </xsl:variable>
    <xsl:sequence select="array:fold-left(array{$datatypes}, map{}, function($m, $v) { map:put($m, fn:replace(fn:replace($v('name'), ':', '-'), 'xs-', 'xsd-'), $v) })"/>
  </xsl:template>

  <xsl:template match="xs:simpleType" as="map(*)*">
    <xsl:param name="name"/>
    <xsl:param name="documentation"/>
    <xsl:variable name="base" select="(xs:string(xs:restriction/@base), fn:tokenize(xs:union/@memberTypes, ' '))"/>
    <xsl:sequence select="map {
      'name': if (@name) then xs:string(@name) else $name,
      'documentation': xs:string((xs:annotation/xs:documentation/text(), $documentation)[1]),
      'base': array{$base},
      'type': if (.//xs:restriction[xs:enumeration]) then 'values'
        else if (.//xs:restriction[xs:pattern]) then 'regex'
        else if (.//xs:restriction[xs:minInclusive or xs:maxInclusive or xs:minExclusive or xs:maxExclusive]) then 'range'
        else 'none',
      'value': if (.//xs:restriction[xs:enumeration]) then fn:fold-left(.//xs:restriction/xs:enumeration, array{}, function($a, $v) {
        array:append($a, map {
          'value': xs:string($v/@value),
          'documentation': xs:string($v/xs:annotation/xs:documentation/text())
        })
      }) else if (.//xs:restriction[xs:pattern]) then xs:string(.//xs:restriction/xs:pattern/@value)
      else if (.//xs:restriction[xs:minInclusive or xs:maxInclusive or xs:minExclusive or xs:maxExclusive]) then fn:fold-left(.//xs:restriction/*, map{}, function($m, $v) {
        map:put($m, $v/local-name(), xs:string($v/@value))
      }) else ()
    }"/>
    <xsl:for-each select="$base">
      <xsl:if test="starts-with(current(), 'xs:')">
        <xsl:sequence select="map {
          'name': current(),
          'documentation': 'See the [definition in the W3C XML Schema standard](https://www.w3.org/TR/xmlschema-2/#' || fn:tokenize(current(), ':')[2] || ').',
          'type': 'none'
        }"/>
      </xsl:if>
    </xsl:for-each>
  </xsl:template>

  <xsl:template mode="xs-ref" match="xs:attribute[@ref]">
    <xsl:variable name="schema" select="if (fn:tokenize(@ref , ':')[1] = 'xlink') then $xlink else $xml"/>
    <xsl:apply-templates mode="xs-schema" select="$schema//xs:attribute[@name=fn:tokenize(current()/@ref , ':')[2]]">
      <xsl:with-param name="schema" select="fn:tokenize(@ref , ':')[1]"/>
    </xsl:apply-templates>
  </xsl:template>

  <xsl:template mode="xs-schema" match="xs:attribute">
    <xsl:param name="schema"/>
    <xsl:choose>
      <xsl:when test="xs:simpleType">
        <xsl:apply-templates select="xs:simpleType">
          <xsl:with-param name="name" select="$schema || ':' || xs:string(@name)"/>
          <xsl:with-param name="documentation" select="xs:annotation/xs:documentation/text()"/>
        </xsl:apply-templates>
      </xsl:when>
      <xsl:otherwise>
        <xsl:sequence select="map {
          'name': $schema || ':' || xs:string(@name),
          'documentation': xs:string(xs:annotation/xs:documentation/text()),
          'base': array{xs:string(@type)},
          'type': 'none',
          'value': ()
        }"/>
      </xsl:otherwise>
    </xsl:choose>
  </xsl:template>

  <xsl:template mode="xs-type" match="xs:attribute[@type]">
    <xsl:sequence select="map {
      'name': xs:string(@type),
      'documentation': 'See the [definition in the W3C XML Schema standard](https://www.w3.org/TR/xmlschema-2/#' || fn:tokenize(@type, ':')[2] || ').',
      'type': 'none'
    }"/>
  </xsl:template>

  <xsl:template match="xs:extension[@base]">
    <xsl:sequence select="map {
      'name': xs:string(@base),
      'documentation': 'See the [definition in the W3C XML Schema standard](https://www.w3.org/TR/xmlschema-2/#' || fn:tokenize(@base, ':')[2] || ').',
      'type': 'none'
    }"/>
  </xsl:template>
</xsl:stylesheet>

FILE: docs/src/xsl/elements-tree.xsl
================================================
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>

<!--
  Generate a hierarchical JSON listing of all elements in an XSD schema.
-->

<xsl:stylesheet
  version="3.0"
  xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform"
  xmlns:xs="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"
  xmlns:map="http://www.w3.org/2005/xpath-functions/map"
  xmlns:array="http://www.w3.org/2005/xpath-functions/array"
  xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"
  xmlns:fn="http://www.w3.org/2005/xpath-functions"
  exclude-result-prefixes="#all"
>
  <xsl:output method="json" indent="yes" encoding="UTF-8"/>

  <!-- Build an XML hierarchy of elements based on the XSD schema. -->
  <xsl:mode on-no-match="deep-skip"/>
  <xsl:mode name="hierarchy" on-no-match="deep-skip"/>
  <xsl:mode name="attributes" on-no-match="deep-skip"/>

  <xsl:template match="/">
    <xsl:variable name="hierarchy" as="element()*">
      <xsl:apply-templates select="xs:schema/xs:element" mode="hierarchy">
        <xsl:with-param name="parents" select="()"/>
      </xsl:apply-templates>
    </xsl:variable>
    <xsl:call-template name="output">
      <xsl:with-param name="hierarchy" select="$hierarchy"/>
    </xsl:call-template>
  </xsl:template>

  <xsl:template match="xs:element" mode="hierarchy">
    <xsl:param name="parents"/>
    <!--
      SPECIAL CASE!! We need to differentiate between <measure> and <part>
      in their <score-partwise> and <score-timewise> version, so we "invent"
      new tag names for each. We will need to do the opposite work on the frontend,
      i.e. bring those invented tag names back to the real ones.
    -->
    <xsl:variable name="element-name" select="
      if (@name = 'part') then (
        if ($parents = 'score-partwise') then 'part-partwise' else 'part-timewise'
      ) else if (@name = 'measure') then (
        if ($parents = 'score-timewise') then 'measure-timewise' else 'measure-partwise'
      ) else @name
    "/>
    <xsl:element name="{$element-name}">
      <xsl:if test="not($parents = $element-name)">
        <xsl:apply-templates select="
          xs:element |
          xs:complexType |
          xs:sequence |
          xs:group[@ref] |
          xs:choice |
          /xs:schema/xs:complexType[@name=current()/@type]
        " mode="#current">
          <xsl:with-param name="parents" select="($parents, $element-name)"/>
        </xsl:apply-templates>
      </xsl:if>
    </xsl:element>
  </xsl:template>

  <xsl:template match="xs:complexType | xs:sequence | xs:choice | xs:group[@name]" mode="hierarchy">
    <xsl:param name="parents"/>
    <xsl:apply-templates select="xs:element | xs:complexType | xs:sequence | xs:group[@ref] | xs:choice" mode="#current">
      <xsl:with-param name="parents" select="$parents"/>
    </xsl:apply-templates>
  </xsl:template>

  <xsl:template match="xs:group[@ref]" mode="hierarchy">
    <xsl:param name="parents"/>
    <xsl:apply-templates select="/xs:schema/xs:group[@name=current()/@ref]" mode="#current">
      <xsl:with-param name="parents" select="$parents"/>
    </xsl:apply-templates>
  </xsl:template>

  <!-- Convert the element hierarchy to final output. -->
  <xsl:template name="output">
    <xsl:param name="hierarchy"/>
    <xsl:variable name="root" as="item()*">
      <xsl:apply-templates select="$hierarchy"/>
    </xsl:variable>
    <xsl:sequence select="fn:fold-left($root, map{}, function($m, $v) { map:merge(($m, $v)) })"/>
  </xsl:template>

  <xsl:template match="node()">
    <xsl:variable name="children" as="map(*)*">
      <xsl:for-each-group select="*" group-by="node-name()">
        <xsl:apply-templates select="."/>
      </xsl:for-each-group>
    </xsl:variable>
    <xsl:sequence select="map {
      xs:string(node-name()): fn:fold-left($children, map{}, function($m, $v) { map:merge(($m, $v)) })
    }"/>
  </xsl:template>
</xsl:stylesheet>
